in_marathi.name: Maheshkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Mountain (Mahesh) + Compassionate (Kumar)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maheshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maheshkumar is a compound name derived from the words Mahesh and Kumar. Mahesh is a name for Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of the mountains, and Kumar refers to a young man or a god in a youthful form. The name thus symbolizes the god of the mountains being compassionate towards his devotees.

The name thus symbolizes the god of the mountains being compassionate towards his devotees.
